summary: Destructor-style helper that conditionally frees two pointer fields of this: first the pointer at offset 0x0C, then the pointer at offset 0x04, each only when non-NULL, via FreeWrapper_7bcf. Returns the result of the last free call that fired, or 0 when neither pointer was set.

operations.description: Read the pointer field at offset 0x0C into the running result.
Guard: only free the field at offset 0x0C when it is non-NULL.
Call FreeWrapper_7bcf on the pointer at offset 0x0C and keep its return value as result.
Read the pointer field at offset 0x04.
Guard: only free the field at offset 0x04 when it is non-NULL.
Call FreeWrapper_7bcf on the pointer at offset 0x04 and return its result.
Return the result of the last free call, or the earlier result / 0 when neither field was set.

unresolved: Object type owning the two freed pointer fields is unknown.
Whether offsets 0x04 and 0x0C are sibling members of one object or separate allocations is not proven here.
